Laughing Sam

Overview

A rocky peninsula juts into the Ocean of Bitter Regrets (00.06). At its very end is a small and twisted willow leaning well over the Ocean. At its base rests a boy with a battered straw hat tugged over his eyes. This is Laughing Sam.
